set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H00.1
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Engineering release lead
Scope: Prove the six areas coexist in one candidate build before the final demo guide is issued.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H00 (bd-01M4X8M9WZPHVERYB9VPD23XD3)
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Build one candidate artifact and bind all six area receipts to its source/configuration/fixtures; rerun affected checks when an input changes and explain reuse of unaffected evidence.
2. On that build perform historical upgrade, two-lab/guest intake-correction-export-review, concurrent offboarding, slow-client/disk-capacity failures, backup then revocation/withdrawal, source isolation and closed restore; compare current permissions and exact historical bytes throughout.
3. Publish an evidence manifest with no unresolved integrity/access/false-completion blocker, the measured engineering envelope, raw failures/retests and explicit physical-failure-domain/human/institutional limits. A guide or successful happy path alone cannot pass this task.

Verification: Integrated executable rehearsal and retained release dossier; every mandatory check observed, no old test-count substitution.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H00.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H01: bd-01M4X8M9386WG7Z2RW1J2C2RBB
- H02: bd-01M4X8M986VW0MMZ2S4AQDC58C
- H03: bd-01M4X8M9CTMTKZHBKG8T9E8EDS
- H04: bd-01M4X8M9GWYPFKAAZVHK760RSN
- H05: bd-01M4X8M9N0FV6ANAHVQ147KJNE
- H06: bd-01M4X8M9S1X431HCYR55D69QA5
- L01.5: bd-01M4X5MAF3ZKCM0TKD58Z7M0MP

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H00.1: Run the integrated core release and failure rehearsal
